scanner_doubts: qe-math-010 is counted 3 times (299, 393, 446) but bare $E$ is used as the expectation operator at least five more times without being counted: `E_0 \sum_{t=0}^\infty` at 113 and 462, `E d(s_{t+j})| s_t` at 397, and `E V(d(s_{t+j}))| s_t` at 431. The documented guard only counts a bare `E` that is applied to `[`, `\{` or `(`, so an expectation applied to a `\sum` or to a function name slips through - and here the text says in words at 114 that '$E_0$ is the mathematical expectation operator', so there is no ambiguity with a matrix named $E$
